blockers.title: OBL-2 is untruthfully removed from leftover-design while its five acceptance-cell harness specifications remain unauthored
blockers.finding: The live DR-101 acceptance-evidence cell requires both a reviewed closure inventory/dependency graph and gate harnesses DR-G01-G05. The subject classifies OBL-2, the gate-harness fragment, as leftoverDesign false and includes it in capableOfRidingNamedGates, while its own reason concedes: 'Naming is not execution. Not authored.' All five live gate cells likewise say not authored, and none of the five future harness artifact paths exists. D-056 eligibility gate 2 permits only harness execution, fixture execution, or qualification measurement to remain; it expressly excludes authoring and separately states that authoring harness specifications remains design work. A named identifier and owner satisfy neither the missing harness-specification authoring nor D-056 gate 2. Therefore the summary's exhaustive leftoverDesign list of only OBL-D1 and OBL-D2 is false even though the subject correctly refuses present eligibility.

shouldFix.title: The execution-owner field substitutes the DR-101 row owner for the different live gate owners
shouldFix.finding: Every non-leftover obligation uses the single value 'Architecture + release engineering' even when its existingGate set includes G01, G03, G04, or G05. The live owner cells are Release engineering for G01/G03/G04, Architecture + release for G02, and Component publisher + release for G05. In particular, the subject omits the component publisher from every obligation routed through G05. Because D-056 gate 3 is explicitly an owner-bearing condition-4 join, this field should enumerate the actual owner for each cited gate or be renamed and clearly identified as the DR-101 register-row owner rather than execution custody.

summary: REJECT at 1 blocker and 1 SHOULD-FIX. The frozen pins, two reserved open decisions, four-platform scope, required-now count, G30 boundary, and authority refusals reproduce. The central leftover split does not: OBL-2 is an acceptance-evidence member whose five harness identifiers are named but whose harness specifications remain unauthored. D-056 treats that authoring as design work, so OBL-2 cannot be classified as execution-only or omitted from the exhaustive leftover list. Separately, the execution-owner values do not reproduce the distinct live G01-G05 owner cells.
